ball.q: Edwin van der Sar scored his only career goal in May 1998, a penalty with Ajax already 7-0 up. Against whom?
ball.sub: He had missed a penalty for Ajax against Sparta a few years earlier.

ball.q: Which FC Den Bosch goalkeeper scored the Eredivisie's first goalkeeper goal from open play, in 1985?
ball.sub: It made it 2-2 against Roda JC in the last minute, and he celebrated with a cartwheel.

ball.q: In 1975 Guus Hiddink's shot for De Graafschap went wide, a team-mate kicked the ball into the net as a joke, and what did the referee do?
ball.sub: Sietze Veen's joke, against Haarlem. The linesman backed the referee.

ball.q: Johan Cruyff's first Klassieker in a Feyenoord shirt, in September 1983, ended with what score?
ball.sub: Feyenoord still won the double that season.

ball.q: Marco van Basten's Ajax debut in April 1982 came as a substitute for which player?
ball.sub: He scored in a 5-0 win over NEC, aged 17.

ball.q: The Amsterdam Arena opened in August 1996 with Ajax losing 0-3 to which club?
ball.sub: Dejan Savićević scored the first goal in the stadium.

ball.q: De Kuip opened in March 1937 with a 5-2 friendly win over a club from which country?
ball.sub: A friendly was chosen so the entrances and buffets could be tested first.

ball.q: Ajax's last match at De Meer, in April 1996, ended 5-1 against which club?
ball.sub: Finidi George scored a hat-trick. Willem II's Jack de Gier got the last goal at the ground.

ball.q: Before the Arena, Ajax played their big European nights at which Amsterdam ground rather than De Meer?
Ajax won the 1972 European Cup final against Inter in which Dutch stadium?
Sparta's ground is called Het Kasteel. Why?
ball.a: A small castle-like building with two towers, left from the 1916 ground

ball.q: NEC's Goffert stadium was built in the 1930s as what kind of project?
ball.a: A work-relief scheme for the unemployed
ball.sub: It took 202,417 working days. NEC only moved in after the war.

ball.q: FC Groningen's Euroborg, opened in 2006, was built with which extras inside the stadium?
ball.a: A cinema, a casino and a supermarket

ball.q: Who were the first champions of Dutch professional football, in 1955?
ball.sub: Sealed on 20 July with a 3-2 win at Eindhoven.

ball.q: Which Eindhoven club, not PSV, were Dutch champions in 1954, the last title of the amateur era?
Which club, later famous for its plastic pitch, were Dutch champions in 1927 and 1941?
Which club won back-to-back Dutch championships in 1942 and 1943, during the occupation?
Which Hague club had won ten Dutch championships by 1914, at a time when Ajax had none?
In 1969-70 Ajax lost 2-1 to AZ '67 in the cup and still went through to the quarter-final. How?
ball.a: As a lucky loser, the best beaten team went through
ball.sub: Rinus Michels called it a crazy business. Ajax went on to beat PSV 2-0 in the final.

ball.q: The phrase Lucky Ajax first appeared in De Telegraaf in 1958, copied from a nickname for which English club?
Which Amsterdam merger club knocked Inter out of the 1974-75 UEFA Cup and was dissolved seven years later?
ball.sub: Blauw-Wit plus DWS. Cologne beat them in the quarter-final.

ball.q: PEC Zwolle are 'de Blauwvingers'. According to legend, how did the people of Zwolle get blue fingers?
ball.a: Counting the copper coins Kampen paid them for their church bells

ball.q: PSV's Coen Dillen, 43 goals in 1956-57, was known by which nickname?
At Barcelona, Johan Neeskens was nicknamed after the more famous team-mate he had also played with at Ajax. What was it?
De Graafschap's most fanatical fans stand on a terrace named after a famous Liverpool one. What is it called?
ball.sub: A Dutch corruption of Anfield's Spion Kop, nothing to do with spiders.

ball.q: NAC Breda's hardcore stand is known by which single letter?
Sparta were relegated for the first time in their history in 2002. Which famous name was their coach?
ball.sub: Within eighteen months he was managing Barcelona.

ball.q: Which Dutch pop singer became chairman of FC Volendam in 2022 and was removed by the supervisory board in 2023?
ball.sub: The board he led was dismissed as a whole in November 2023.

ball.q: Which Ajax midfielder stood juggling the ball in the middle of a 1973 European Cup semi-final at the Bernabéu?
What was Rinus Michels' day job when Ajax hired him in January 1965?
ball.a: PE teacher at a school for deaf children

ball.q: Which Welsh coach gave a 16-year-old Ruud Gullit his debut at Haarlem in 1979?
ball.sub: The same man who added Eagles to Go Ahead's name.

ball.q: Johan Cruyff came back to Ajax in December 1981, aged 34. What did the club win in 1982 and 1983?
ball.a: Two league titles, and the 1983 KNVB Cup as well
ball.sub: Then they let him go, and he did the double at Feyenoord.

ball.q: In 2011 Johan Cruyff took Ajax, his own club, to court. What was he so angry about?
ball.a: He had not been told the board was making Louis van Gaal chief executive
ball.sub: The judge agreed and voided the appointment.

ball.q: Which Ajax goalkeeper scored a penalty to complete an 8-1 win over De Graafschap in 1997-98?
Ajax retired the number 14 in Johan Cruyff's honour in 2007. What did Cruyff himself say about it?
ball.a: That the club should let its best player wear it

ball.q: PSV have retired two shirt numbers. The 12 belongs to the fans. Who has the 99?
Which Brabant singer has filled PSV's Philips Stadion with concerts every summer since 2006?
For decades a playing contract at PSV came with something extra attached. What was it?
An Eros Ramazzotti concert in 1994 put PSV's board off staging events for years. What had gone wrong?
ball.a: The crowd trampled the pitch to ruin

ball.q: A gorilla that escaped from Rotterdam zoo in 2007 became an unofficial Feyenoord mascot. What was he called?
In 2013 Feyenoord's shirt carried a Rotterdam attraction that was short of money. Which one?
ball.sub: Its elephant Olli became an unofficial mascot.

ball.q: How are Feyenoord's new signings delivered onto the pitch at the club's traditional open day?
Which club won the 1963 KNVB Cup and was relegated from the Eredivisie in the same season?
ball.sub: They beat ADO 3-0 in the final and finished 15th of 16 in the league.

ball.q: ADO's farewell match at its ground of 80 years was abandoned after 50 minutes in April 2007. Name the ground.
ball.sub: Against Groningen, 0-3 down, stopped because of the crowd. ADO had played there since 1927.

ball.q: Ruud Geels scored five in a 6-0 Ajax win in November 1975. Who were the opponents?
ball.sub: Geels finished the season as top scorer with 29 goals.

ball.q: Which Schiedam club played its 1990-91 home games at De Kuip because the KNVB rejected its own ground?
ball.sub: Sportpark Harga was not approved for Eredivisie football.

ball.q: Which Frisian legend lost the 1958 title decider with Sportclub Enschede and never won a national championship?
ball.sub: Lost in the 109th minute of a sudden-death play-off, 1-0 to DOS at the Goffert.

ball.q: Ajax left Sebastien Haller off a squad list in February 2021. What did the mistake cost him?
ball.a: His place in the Europa League knockout rounds

ball.q: Telstar came up in 2025 after 47 years away and stayed up on the final day. Which fellow promoted club did they beat?
A 6-0 Go Ahead Eagles win over NAC Breda in 2025-26 ended up in a Utrecht court. What was the row about?
ball.a: Dean James turned out to have given up his Dutch citizenship
ball.sub: The KNVB warned a replay could open more than 130 other matches to challenge.

ball.q: PSV were crowned champions on 5 April 2026 without kicking a ball. What handed them the title?
ball.a: Feyenoord could only draw 0-0 with Volendam

ball.q: Ajax led the 2024-25 Eredivisie by nine points with five rounds left. How did the season end?
ball.a: PSV caught them and won the title by one point

ball.q: Go Ahead Eagles reached the Europa League in 2025-26 and beat which English club 2-1 at home?
Inter got Andre Onana from Ajax for nothing in 2022. What did they sell him for a year later?
ball.a: About 44 million pounds, to Manchester United

ball.q: Ajax signed Frenkie de Jong from Willem II in 2015 for a symbolic fee. How much was it?
ball.sub: Willem II took a ten per cent sell-on instead, and cashed in four years later.

ball.q: Vitesse lost their professional licence in the summer of 2025. How were they playing again by September?
ball.a: They won an appeal in court and got the licence back

ball.q: Heracles Almelo finished bottom of the 2025-26 Eredivisie on 19 points, but won one match 8-2. Against whom?
Ajax paid Willem II a symbolic fee for Frenkie de Jong in 2015. How much?
ball.a: One euro, plus a ten percent sell-on clause

ball.q: Erik Pieters was sent off on his PSV comeback in January 2013 and then hurt his arm badly. How?
Which Heerenveen striker scored seven goals in one Eredivisie match in October 2007?
ball.sub: It came in a 9-0 win over Heracles Almelo on 7 October 2007.

ball.q: Luis Suárez was banned for seven matches in 2010 for biting an opponent in Ajax against PSV. Who did he bite?
ball.sub: The Dutch press christened him the Cannibal of Ajax.

ball.q: What did the Feyenoord goalkeeper Eddy Treijtel hit with a goal kick at Sparta in November 1970?
ball.a: A seagull, which fell dead on the pitch
ball.sub: Both clubs claim to have the stuffed bird in their museum.

ball.q: Which goalkeeper scored seven Eredivisie goals, more than any other keeper up to 2017-18?
ball.sub: Six of them came for Go Ahead, and he added two in the second tier.

ball.q: The trophy for the least beaten keeper in Dutch football is named after a GVAV goalkeeper. What happened to him in June 1971?
ball.a: He died in a car crash driving home from the KNVB ceremony
ball.sub: Tonny van Leeuwen was 28.

ball.q: Which Ajax goalkeeper of the European Cup years was nicknamed Heinz Kroket for the way he fumbled high balls?
ball.sub: Fans said he dropped them like a hot croquette.

ball.q: Which goalkeeper answered to De Beer van de Meer, De Bolle van Zwolle and Het Lek van PEC?
Which Vitesse defender scored his first Eredivisie goal in 2017, after 303 matches without one?
ball.sub: It came against Sparta Rotterdam on 10 March 2017.

ball.q: An FC Twente player set a grim Eredivisie record in 1987-88 by getting injured after how long?
ball.sub: The unlucky man was Freddy ten Caat.

ball.q: Which club scored three own goals in one match at PSV in October 1989?
ball.sub: Hans Linders got two of them on his own.

ball.q: Roelof Luinge's last professional match was a cup tie between Feyenoord and Ajax in May 2010. How did it end for him?
ball.a: He was substituted in the 88th minute so the crowd could applaud him

ball.q: Ajax won 12-1 at home to Vitesse in 1972 and 13-0 away in October 2020. Which club shipped the 13-0?
ball.sub: It finished 0-13 in Venlo.

ball.q: Johan Cruyff, Johan Neeskens and Dick van Dijk all did the same thing in Ajax's 12-1 win over Vitesse in 1972. What?
ball.sub: Cruyff actually took four, in Dick van Dijk's farewell match.

ball.q: Which Dutch keeper was still turning out in the Eredivisie for Go Ahead Eagles at the age of 44, in 1985?
ball.sub: He was 44 years, 9 months and 14 days old.

ball.q: Which Ajax coach resigned in December 2010, making way for Frank de Boer?
ball.sub: Feyenoord had ten men from the 34th minute. Their previous worst was an 8-2 loss to Ajax in 1983.

ball.q: In May 2016 the KNVB licensing committee ordered which club relegated for financial mismanagement, a decision overturned on appeal?
ball.sub: The appeal committee overturned it on 17 June 2016. Twente went down on the pitch two years later anyway.

ball.q: Go Ahead Eagles are called Kowet. Where does the name come from?
ball.a: Deventer workers mangling the English name Go Ahead in their dialect
ball.sub: The posh rival club UD laughed at the pronunciation, so the fans kept it as a badge of honour.

ball.q: Which shirt number do Go Ahead Eagles refuse to give to a player, and why?
ball.a: Number 12, it belongs to the supporters as the twelfth man

ball.q: Go Ahead's biggest ever win, 11-1 in October 1962, came against which Limburg club?
ball.sub: Roda had only been formed that summer from Rapid JC and Roda Sport.

ball.q: A former Ajax, Arsenal and Barcelona winger came out of retirement at 35 to play the 2008-09 season for Go Ahead Eagles. Who?
ball.sub: 24 games, no goals, and his knee gave up again after one season.

ball.q: De Graafschap won the 2010 Eerste Divisie title at home to Go Ahead after being 2-0 down. How did it end?
ball.a: 3-2, with goals in the 86th and 89th minutes
ball.sub: Muslu Nalbantoglu scored the winner in the 89th minute.

ball.q: Johan Voskamp made his Sparta debut on 20 August 2010 against Almere City. What did he do?
ball.a: Scored eight goals in a 12-1 win
ball.sub: He had joined from Helmond Sport that summer. The 12-1 equalled a Dutch record.

ball.q: In the 2010 Rotterdam play-off at Sparta, Excelsior's Guyon Fernandez missed a late penalty and Sparta scored in stoppage time. Then what?
ball.a: Fernandez equalised in the 94th minute, Excelsior went up on away goals and Sparta went down

ball.q: In 1974 Excelsior played with a large letter A on the shirt when shirt sponsors were banned. What was the A for?
ball.a: Akai, the electronics firm paying them, though the club claimed it meant A-team
ball.sub: Shirt sponsors were legal from 1982, and Akai went straight back on.

ball.q: Excelsior named a stand at Woudestein after a striker who spent two years in their youth academy before Feyenoord. Who?
In November 1970 Feyenoord keeper Eddy Treijtel killed a seagull with a goal kick at Het Kasteel. Why does that still annoy Sparta fans?
ball.a: The stuffed bird is in Feyenoord's museum, not Sparta's

ball.q: Which Rotterdam club had Georginio Wijnaldum, Memphis Depay and Kevin Strootman in its youth ranks before they became famous elsewhere?
ball.sub: Strootman is the one who actually made the Sparta first team.

ball.q: Heerenveen won 5-0 at Excelsior on 10 December 2011. What was remarkable about the scoring?
ball.sub: He finished the season as top scorer with 32 and left for Wolfsburg.

ball.q: Trond Sollied won Heerenveen their first ever major trophy, the 2009 KNVB Cup, in May. What happened to him on 31 August?
ball.a: He was sacked, three months after winning the cup

ball.q: Bonaventure Kalou scored in Heerenveen's 2009 cup final win. What did he get himself elected as in Ivory Coast in 2018?
ball.sub: His younger brother Salomon also played for Feyenoord.

ball.q: The Abe Lenstra Stadion opened in August 1994 with Heerenveen against PSV. Which teenager made his European debut for PSV that day?
AZ became champions on 19 April 2009 without playing. What had happened?
ball.a: PSV beat Ajax 6-2, so nobody could catch AZ anymore
ball.sub: AZ had lost 2-1 at Vitesse the day before.

ball.q: Why did the letters DSB come down off AZ's stadium in November 2009?
ball.a: DSB Bank, the sponsor owned by chairman Dirk Scheringa, had gone bankrupt
ball.sub: For that autumn's Champions League games it was called the Dirk Scheringa Stadion.

ball.q: AZ beat PSV 2-1 on Saturday 28 September 2013. What did the club do to coach Gertjan Verbeek on the Sunday morning?
ball.a: Sacked him, citing a lack of chemistry with the players
ball.sub: Verbeek had won them the cup four months earlier.

ball.q: Vitesse captain Guram Kashia wore a rainbow armband against Heracles in October 2017. What was the reaction back home in Georgia?
ball.a: Protests outside the federation and calls to drop him from the national team
ball.sub: UEFA gave him its first ever EqualGame award for it.

ball.q: Vitesse waited 125 years for a first major trophy. Who scored both goals in the 2017 cup final, both in the last ten minutes?
ball.sub: 2-0 against AZ, on 30 April 2017, under Henk Fraser.

ball.q: In May 2016 the KNVB licensing committee took Twente's Eredivisie licence away and put them in the Eerste Divisie. How did Twente stay up?
ball.a: They won on appeal in June and got a fine of 181,000 euros instead

ball.q: Twente trailed Ajax 2-1 early in the second half of the 2011 KNVB Cup final. How did it finish?
ball.a: 3-2 to Twente after extra time, Marc Janko scoring in the 117th minute
ball.sub: Nacer Chadli and Roy Beerens got the other Twente goals.

ball.q: Twente sold Ola John to Benfica in 2012. Which investment fund was reported to have taken about 80 percent of the fee?
ball.a: Doyen Sports, an investment fund that part-owned the player
ball.sub: The fund part-owned the player. The Doyen deals fed the crisis that nearly sank Twente.

ball.q: The 2014 KNVB Cup final was stopped in the fifth minute with Ajax 1-0 up against PEC Zwolle. Why, and how did it end?
ball.a: Ajax fans threw fireworks on the pitch, and after a half-hour break PEC won 5-1

ball.q: Where does the name Cambuur come from?
ball.a: The Camminghaburg, a castle of the Van Cammingha family that stood where the stadium was built
ball.sub: The combs on the badge are a pun on the family name Cammingha.

ball.q: FC Dordrecht fans are the Schapenkoppen, the sheep heads. What is the story behind it?
ball.a: Two men tried to smuggle a dressed-up sheep past the city gates in 1866 and it bleated

ball.q: De Graafschap put seats on the Spinnekop terrace in the late 1990s. What did the club do in 2008?
ball.a: Took the seats out again after supporter protests
ball.sub: The name comes from the Spion Kop, the Boer War hill.

ball.q: NAC's stadium is named after Antoon Verlegh. How did he get the nickname Rat?
ball.a: He played like a ratje, sly and hard to knock off the ball
ball.sub: His mother hated the nickname.

ball.q: Alireza Jahanbakhsh scored two late goals at Ajax on the last day of 2013-14 to keep NEC out of the automatic relegation places. And then?
ball.a: NEC lost the play-off and went down anyway

ball.q: Roda JC took on a Dubai-based investor in January 2017 who brought Nicolas Anelka in as adviser. What happened to the investor within weeks?
ball.a: Aleksei Korotaev was arrested in Dubai over an uncovered cheque of 17.7 million euros

ball.q: Daryl Werker scored for MVV in the 2016 play-offs while on loan from Roda. What did he do in the 2017 play-off final?
ball.a: Headed the only goal of the tie for Roda JC against MVV
ball.sub: 0-0 in Maastricht, 1-0 in Kerkrade, Roda stayed up.

ball.q: MVV lost 3-1 at home to Almere City in the 2018 play-offs. What was odd about Almere's hat-trick hero Damon Mirani?
ball.a: A central defender, he scored with his left foot, his right foot and his head

ball.q: In 2010 MVV changed what the M stands for. It had been Maastrichtse. What did it become?
ball.a: Maatschappelijke, the socially responsible football club
ball.sub: The full name became Maatschappelijke Voetbal Vereniging Maastricht.

ball.q: MVV's hardcore stand is the Angel Side. Which angel?
ball.a: The angel in the coat of arms of the city of Maastricht
ball.sub: The city arms show an armed angel holding a red shield with a white star.

ball.q: VVV-Venlo play at De Koel. What does koel mean in Venlo dialect, and why is it apt?
ball.a: A pit or hollow, the ground is literally built in one, with the stands on its sides
ball.sub: Players walk down a long staircase from the dressing rooms to the pitch.

ball.q: On 11 September 2011 a VVV-Venlo defender scored a spectacular bicycle kick against PSV in a 3-3 draw. Who was he?
ball.sub: He went to Southampton a year later.

ball.q: What did VVV-Venlo fans nickname Keisuke Honda in his 2008-09 promotion season?
Fortuna Sittard suspended coach Sunday Oliseh in February 2018 while second in the table. What was his explanation?
ball.a: He said he was removed for refusing to take part in illegal activities at the club
ball.sub: The club only said he had been put on non-active. Fortuna went up anyway.

ball.q: In 2016 the KNVB confirmed match-fixing in a 2009 Eredivisie game, a Willem II defeat at Utrecht. Which player made the deal?
ball.a: Ibrahim Kargbo, with fixer Wilson Raj Perumal
ball.sub: Utrecht won that match 1-0 on 9 August 2009.

ball.q: In 2016 ADO Den Haag took its own majority owner to court over unpaid promised money. Who was he?
ball.a: Wang Hui of United Vansen, the Chinese company that took over the club in 2015
ball.sub: The Enterprise Chamber suspended him as supervisory board chairman in December 2016.

ball.q: ADO beat Groningen 5-1 at home in the 2011 play-off final for a Europa League place. What happened in the return?
ball.a: Groningen won 5-1 too, and ADO won the shoot-out with ten men
ball.sub: ADO had Mitchell Pique sent off in the 88th minute of the second leg.

ball.q: Utrecht lost the first leg of the 2017 European play-off final 3-0 at AZ. How did the second leg go?
ball.a: Utrecht won 3-0, AZ keeper Tim Krul saved a stoppage-time penalty, and Utrecht won the shoot-out 4-3

ball.q: What is wrong with the city coat of arms on FC Utrecht's badge?
ball.a: The diagonal runs the wrong way, it is mirrored
ball.sub: It happened in September 1982 and has never been properly explained.

ball.q: Frans van Seumeren bought 63 percent of FC Utrecht in April 2008. Which Feyenoord legend did he sack as coach that December?
What does Galgenwaard, the name of FC Utrecht's ground, mean?
ball.sub: The rebuilt 1982 stadium was famous for the dry moats around the pitch.

ball.q: After a 0-0 at Aberdeen in 2014, Groningen's Filip Kostic said they had done 80 percent of the job. What happened in the return?
ball.a: Groningen lost 2-1 at home and went out
ball.sub: Aberdeen's Jonny Hayes said he enjoyed ramming the words down their throats.

ball.q: Besides football, what can you find inside Groningen's Euroborg complex?
ball.a: A casino, a cinema, a school, a supermarket and a gym

ball.q: Volendam finished bottom of the Eredivisie in 2008-09, yet reached the cup semi-finals. Which giant did they beat 1-0 in round three?
ball.sub: Jack Tuijp scored in the 111th minute at the Kras Stadion.

ball.q: Which striker scored 176 goals for Volendam and, in a later spell at Helmond Sport, finished a match in goal?
ball.sub: Helmond had used all their subs and their keeper had been sent off.

ball.q: NEC sacked Alex Pastoor on 19 August 2013, the earliest sacking in an Eredivisie season. What had just happened?
ball.a: A 5-1 home defeat to PEC Zwolle

ball.q: Marinus Dijkhuizen took Excelsior up in 2014 and kept them up. How long did his next job, at Brentford in 2015, last?
ball.a: Nine matches, and he was gone by the end of September
ball.sub: Two wins, two draws and five defeats.

ball.q: Dwight Lodeweges coached Cambuur in the Eredivisie in 2013-14. Where did he go on 1 April 2014, with the season still running?
ball.a: To Heerenveen, the Frisian derby rivals

ball.q: Willem II's Spanish striker Fran Sol, a Real Madrid youth product, published something unusual in 2020. What?
ball.sub: He also learned French, Dutch, English and Russian.

ball.q: Heracles trailed Groningen 3-1 on aggregate with eight minutes left in the 2016 European play-off semi-final. Final aggregate?
ball.a: 6-3 to Heracles, after a 5-1 second leg in extra time
ball.sub: Zomer, Gladon, Weghorst, Darri and Pelupessy scored.
